title: Projet — détail
description: Détail d'un projet : services, ressources, trafic HTTP et journaux.

options.content:
## 📦 Projet · $project
Services, ressources, trafic HTTP et journaux de ce seul projet. Retour à la liste par le menu « Dashboards » en haut à droite.

targets.expr: (1 - (sum(rate(traefik_router_requests_total{code=~"5..", router=~"$router", router=~"$project-.*", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(traefik_router_requests_total{router=~"$router", router=~"$project-.*", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[5m])), 1e-9)) * 100
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$router", service=~"$project-.*", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (name) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{name!="", project="$project", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{name!="", project="$project", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requêtes par router (req/s)
panels.description: Les panneaux HTTP ne retiennent que les routers nommés « $project-... » (convention de nommage Traefik). La liste « Router » sert à restreindre davantage, par exemple à un seul service du projet.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$router", service=~"$project-.*", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$router", service=~"$project-.*", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$router", service=~"$project-.*", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))

{filename="/logs/traefik/access.log", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"} | json | RouterName =~ "$router" | RouterName =~ "$project-.*" | DownstreamStatus >= 400 | line_format "{{.DownstreamStatus}} {{.RequestMethod}} {{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}} ← {{.ClientHost}}"
